[DEVELOPMENT PREVIEW]{.bs-status-label}

The checker example below uses accepted retained GNU 4-ply evidence and cached Backgammonboard SVGs. The cube and loader-failure cases remain deliberately synthetic. This route is still a development fixture, not a published Analyzer result.
:::

The browser still loads only analysis-view JSON. Retained and future Canonical Parquet records are materialized before the browser boundary, and Backgammonboard renders candidate move-overlay SVGs at build time.

:::

## Retained checker result

The board and move list share one factual starting position. Candidate analysis rows are independent: the top move starts open, and opening another move leaves earlier outcome bars open while changing the board to that candidate's movement overlay.

```{=html}
<div
  class="bs-analysis-results-host"
  data-bs-analysis-results
  data-analysis-id="retained-checker-preview"
  data-analysis-fixture-url="/data/analyzer-retained-checker-preview.json"
></div>
```
